root_idea.summary: The root centers on the opposite of spaciousness: narrowness, straitness, and restricted capacity, extending to material insufficiency, poverty, and mental distress.
root_idea.development: Concrete restriction of space develops into constriction of the chest or mind, inability to cope, and straitened livelihood. Causative and derived forms express making something narrow, treating someone harshly, crowding, or specialized physical constriction.

senses.definition: To become narrow or straitened, especially of a place, expanse, or available space.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of physical space and, in Quranic contexts, of the earth becoming straitened around people. The constriction may be literal in description but expressive of distress in context.

senses.definition: To become mentally constricted, distressed, or unable to cope with something.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes constriction of the chest or mind and the construction ضَاقَ بِهِ ذَرْعًا, ‘to be unable to bear or cope with it’; ضاق به or ضاق عنه may express being overwhelmed or unable to accommodate something.

senses.definition: To make narrow or strait; to impose constriction or hardship on someone.
senses.usage_conditions: May concern a place or thing, or elliptically a person’s circumstances. In the Quranic construction, the straitening includes restricting expenses and creating emotional or psychological pressure.

senses.definition: Constricted or distressed, especially with one’s chest or mind made narrow by something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use is in the construction وَضَائِقٌ بِهِ صَدْرُكَ, describing a chest or mind straitened by a matter.

senses.definition: Mental straitness: distress, unease, or doubt.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a state of inward constriction; in the Quranic contexts it concerns unease or distress in response to hostile plotting or adversity.

senses.definition: Narrow, strait, or confined in physical space.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes a place or other spatial object whose extent or capacity is restricted.

senses.definition: Constricted or distressed, especially in the chest or mind.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative use for inward constriction or distress, as in a chest made narrow and burdened by a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become choked, surcharged, or overfilled with something, such as a watercourse with water or a place with people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Often used with بِهِ for the thing causing the obstruction or overfilling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become restricted or insufficient in livelihood, property, time, or other available means.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a livelihood becoming strait and property proving inadequate for debts.
A figurative characterization of a person’s disposition or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone harshly or with hardness; to deal with someone oppressively in a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An interpersonal Form III usage, also glossed as straitening someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For one’s means of living to become straitened, with loss of property and consequent poverty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV usage concerning livelihood or financial resources.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To crowd, press, or push against one another; to become cramped together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used reciprocally of people in an assembly or confined place; it may also describe becoming inwardly straitened in disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To endeavor to constrict the vagina by means of a pessary or medicaments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical usage explicitly described of a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Narrowness or straitness of a thing, especially a thing that can properly become wider.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the concrete nominal state, distinguished in one lexical analysis from mental straitness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poverty, hardship, or an evil state or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine nominal form used for material or general adversity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a lunar mansion or pair of stars near the Pleiades and Aldebaran, regarded by the Arabs as inauspicious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical and proper-name usage, distinct from the ordinary noun for straitness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Niggardly, avaricious, or narrow in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective describing a person’s liberality or temperament.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A narrow or strait place or pass; also the vulva, and figuratively a straitened livelihood or difficult affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The anatomical, material, and figurative applications belong to this derived noun’s range of reference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An affair or matter rendered strait or restricted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of a matter made difficult or confined.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pessary made of rag and perfume, used to constrict the vagina.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized implement noun associated with the anatomical use of اِسْتَضَاقَ.
